Hi Marta — thanks for the clear list and the RFP summary. Below is a concise written response you can circulate; happy to hop on a 30-min call after you review.

1) Platform fee amortization
   - Default: platform fee is charged at the org level and can be amortized across sites; customers can elect a per-site carve (higher total) if they need per-site invoicing.
   - Practical approach for 3 sites: we typically offer a blended platform fee that scales with total committed nodes. Example: list price $X/month per 100k tokens baseline; blended discount applied at commit tiers.

2) Support retainer vs. platform fee tradeoffs
   - Option A (Lower platform fee + higher retainer): good when you expect heavy SRE collaboration (24x7 on-call overlap, runbook ops). Retainer covers N dedicated hours per month and expedited SLA windows.
   - Option B (Higher platform fee + lower retainer): preferred when the customer wants predictable unit economics and fewer dedicated SRE hours.
   - We can swap ~10–20% of platform fee into retainer dollars at close; exact elasticity depends on commit length.

3) Discounts for >12 months
   - 12–24 month term: typically 8–12% on platform fee at 12 months, sliding to ~15% at 24 months (with modest SRE retainer commit).
   - Node/volume bands: additional 3–7% depending on committed sustained throughput.
   - We're open to a performance-based rebate tied to latency/cost SLAs for large commits.

4) SLA credits and cross-site failover
   - We provide an SLA credit ladder for availability and response times. Cross-site failover is covered when routed under the Dedication plan; credits scale with impact. We'll include specific credit percentages in the SOW.

5) Air-gapped/on-prem installs
   - There is a one-time integration surcharge for air-gapped installs (includes validation, offline package, and on-site enablement). For multi-site installs we offer a per-site reduced surcharge if included in the same contract.

Next steps (my proposal):
- I'll send a draft SOW that shows two packaging alternatives (A and B) with example numbers for 12 and 24 month commits.
- We propose a 30-min alignment call Thursday or Friday this week.

Thanks — Vivek
